_about: Hand corrections to take timings, in seconds within that recording. Use when a flub and its retake were transcribed as one take, or the transcript's timing is wrong (check by listening, or with ffmpeg silencedetect). "rec" names the recording the fix belongs to, so a later pickup of the same line isn't moved by it.

23.why: False start 'To begin, click in the message box and' (91.1-93.2s); the retake starts at 95.1s
